change: With one FFN rank on the direct-NVLink role path, the FFN combine reduces all top_k rows on the branch-free path (prefix top_k) instead of ceil(top_k / union ranks)
afd_basis: With one FFN rank every token's top-k rows are local, so the valid-slot count is exactly top_k on every token; the union prefix counts Attention ranks, which hold no experts. Symmetric EP with two or more ranks never has a fixed full-local count.

why_not_two_or_more_ffn_ranks.reading: In a symmetric 4-rank world a larger prefix is also faster (prefix 8: up to -7.5% at 128 tokens; prefix 4: -4% at 512), so a larger prefix for F>=2 is generic tuning; at 2A2F H4096 the role-sized prefix (4) was +2% to +10% slower.
